title: Redirecting iodine reduction pathways by decoupling adsorption energies for long-life Zn–I2 batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,896-905
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06963G, Paper
Maoxin Chen, Huan Li, Hui Xu, Zhitan Wu, Jinxing Chen, Huihui Lin, Ao Du, Sundus Umer, Zihui Chen, Ning Yue, Zhijie Yan, Tianyu Yin, Nianjun Yang, Jiong Lu, Weichao Wang, Chunpeng Yang, Quan-Hong Yang
Atom-cluster catalysts decouple iodine intermediate adsorption, redirecting reduction from a high-energy *I5 pathway to a low-barrier *I3 route, which enables a long-life Zn–I2 pouch cell at an ultrahigh loading of ∼30 mg cm−2.
